notes.title: Major update (Remastered Edition)
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/fdecef8a67bd7b98a3e8619bf91304a9ef18a552.jpg[/img]
Sorry for the long delay. Appreciate your patience & kind hearty support all these days. 

We are back with a major stable update!

* Stable build! No more crashes! (All reported crashes till date fixed)
* 10$ Music tracks & wallpapers free - Can be saved now to document folder.
* Better Fonts. 
* Supports more display modes
* Dozens of minor fine tuning. :Loved:
* Game Pricing is changed (CE 9.99$, SE $5.99) to match with Bigfish portal pricing where it is all time top-rated. 

Happy gaming!! 

And if you like Darkarta, please do share your reviews at  
http://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/601530


as that can help us create better games tomorrow! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/fa4fbc80546fa6e9ccec2e7a615727362b0ed2dd.jpg[/img]

Looking forward to hear back from you all soon!
Sincerely
Tuttifrutti Crew

notes.title: Attention: For those who lost "saved profile" after last update
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

Some mentioned they lost their profiles after last update.

The profile is not actually lost - in last update we accidentally renamed save location to  "Darkarta_Qflp_Survey" to "Darkarta_ABHQ_CE". 

1. This save location can be found by typing "%APPDATA%/Tuttifrutti_games" in windows search bar like this and pressing enter key
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/ba48a2da49ddd85bb79da413fb687a8957062377.png[/img]

2. The "game save location" window will popup.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/65ddc5a03635efea962631f3188367c63e958b5f.png[/img]

3. "Darkarta_Qflp_Survey" folder contains old save files.
a. Pls delete new folder "Darkarta_ABHQ_CE"
b. Rename "Darkarta_Qflp_Survey" to "Darkarta_ABHQ_CE". 

You can start playing from old save location ːsteamhappyː

Don't forget to thank our friend Azrael for finding this - Azrael will get all future game, dlc for free :)

Here is his original post in case anybody still has confusion.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/601530/discussions/0/1327844097132209427/#c1327844097133806820

Cheers
Tuttifrutti

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

A major bug fix update 

Pros: 
* Widescreen support 
* Fixes crash after credits.
* Collector edition logo 
* Assets fine tuning

Cons: 
* Old profile will be deleted and 1.5 gb download, sorry

If you find any further crash please mail to ajish@tuttifrutti.in 
* Also mention the last scene activity.
* Also please sent us the log.txt file which can be found in steam "game folder"
